description: Search judge/person records by name, appointing president, court, political affiliation, or demographic. Returns biographical data, current position, and appointment summary. Use courtlistener_get_judge for full appointment history and education records.

appointer.description: Filter by appointing president's last name (e.g., "Obama", "Trump", "Biden"). Matches against the appointer field in position records.

court.description: Filter to judges who have held a position at this court (e.g., "scotus", "ca9"). Use court_id strings from courtlistener_lookup_courts.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor field.

page_size.description: Number of results to request (default 20). CourtListener search enforces a minimum of 20 results per page regardless of the value passed.

political_affiliation.description: Filter by political affiliation: d=Democrat, r=Republican, i=Independent, l=Libertarian, g=Green Party, u=Unknown/unconfirmed. Based on party of the appointing president or election affiliation.

q.description: Search query — judge name, court, city, or relevant keywords.

name: courtlistener_search_judges

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_query`: CourtListener rejects caller-authored query or filter syntax with a recognized diagnostic. `rate_limited`: 429 from CourtListener, or no request slot opened within the wait budget. `empty_query`: q is empty or whitespace-only after trimming — no request is sent. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page; null when no more results.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty — echoes filters and suggests how to broaden.

aba_rating.description: ABA qualification labels (e.g. "Well Qualified", "Qualified"), one per rating on record — not the rating codes.

appointer.description: Name of the appointing president (e.g. "Obama, Barack Hussein, II"); null if elected or not recorded.

court.description: Court full name; null for non-judicial positions.

court_id.description: Court identifier for use in filter parameters; null for non-judicial positions.

date_start.description: Date the position started; null if not recorded.

date_termination.description: Date the position ended; null while the judge still holds it.

job_title.description: Free-text title for non-judicial roles (e.g. "Assistant district attorney"); null for judicial positions.

organization_name.description: Employer for non-judicial roles; null for judicial positions.

position_type.description: Judicial position title (e.g. "Judge", "Chief Judge"); null for non-judicial positions — see job_title.

selection_method.description: How the judge reached the position (e.g. "Appointment (President)", "Election (Partisan)"); null if not recorded.

termination_reason.description: Why the position ended (e.g. "Appointed to Other Judgeship", "Retirement"); null while still serving.

current_position.description: The position with no termination date, or — when several or none qualify — the one with the latest start date. Null when the record carries no positions. courtlistener_get_judge returns the full appointment history.

dob.description: Date of birth; null if not recorded.

dob_city.description: City of birth; null if not recorded.

dob_state.description: State of birth; null if not recorded.

person_id.description: Person ID — pass to courtlistener_get_judge for full biography.

political_affiliation.description: Party labels (e.g. "Democratic", "Republican"), one per recorded affiliation — not the single-letter codes the political_affiliation input filter takes.

title: Search Judges
